_comment: Drop this into .claw.json or .claw/settings.json for claw CLI use. For pure Copilot usage, treat this as documentation of the intended defaults.

permissions._comment_defaultMode: Options: dontAsk | ask | denyAll. dontAsk allows workspace-write without prompts; use ask for higher-blast-radius repos.

_comment_model: Override with any alias or full model name. Aliases: opus, sonnet, haiku, grok, grok-mini.

hooks._comment: Hooks run shell scripts at agent lifecycle points. Paths are relative to the repo root.

mcp._comment: Add MCP server definitions here. Each key is a logical server name.
